meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 当用户提供本地文件路径时,Claude 会在本地把 Word、PPT、表格等文档转成 Markdown 文件,并返回文件位置,不会把文档上传到外部服务。
howto.when: 当消息里带有本地附件路径,并且需要在不外传的前提下读取文档时触发。

say.text: 把附件里的文档转成 Markdown 并保存。
say.note: 转换在本机完成,不会上传文件。

say.text: 请把这份本地 Excel 转成 Markdown 再总结。
say.note: 表格排版可能简化,文字会保留。

say.text: 这个本地 PDF 是文字版,能转成 Markdown 吗?
say.note: 扫描版 PDF 会失败并提示原因。

howto.what_en: Converts a local file such as a Word doc, presentation, spreadsheet, PDF, or EPUB into Markdown on the machine, and gives back the Markdown file path without uploading the document anywhere.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the incoming message includes a local attachment path and the file must be read without sending it to an external parser.

say_en.text: Convert the attached document to Markdown and save it.
say_en.note: It converts locally, with no upload.

say_en.text: Turn this local Excel into Markdown and summarize it.
This local PDF is text-based; can you convert it to Markdown?
say_en.note: Scanned PDFs will fail and be reported.
